exposure: Uterine displacement techniques (anatomical position, uterine suspension of round ligaments, ventrofixation of uterine fundus, uterine transposition)
Simulated radiation therapy plans (anal cancer, rectal cancer)
outcome: Maximum radiation dose received by uterus (Dmax)
Mean radiation dose received by uterus (Dmean)
cohort: The study involved a human female cadaver on which uterine displacement techniques were performed and assessed.
finding: Increasing complexity of uterine displacement procedures, with uterine transposition being the most complex, effectively minimizes radiation exposure to the uterus during simulated pelvic radiotherapy.
